summary: Classic space power systems waste too much heat (~27.91% efficiency) and risk mechanical valve failure. I designed MagBiter, a motionless waste-heat recovery system using He + Gd_np, magnets, a Tesla valve, and TEG/Seebeck modules to generate dual-output electricity. MagBiter boosts efficiency to 36.48% (+30.7% more power) and cuts spacecraft mass by 70 kg.
details:
How MagBiter Works:

  • Magnetic Field: Magnets compress the He + Gd_np working fluid and generate extra heat.
  • Tesla Valve: Allows the gas to move forward without mechanical parts and locks the pressure inside.
  • Pressure Room: A constant-volume chamber that boosts pressure up to 14.91 Bar (1100 K).
  • TEG & Seebeck: Temperature difference separates hot He and Gd_np dust. The Gd_np particles generate extra electricity (0.82 kW) via the Seebeck effect and return cooled.
  • Turbine: Clean, hot Helium spins the turbine to generate main electricity (9.18 kW).
  • Space Radiator: Rejects excess heat into space (8.33 m² radiator) and repeats the closed cycle, saving 70 kg of spacecraft mass.

References:

  • NASA Kilopower & Closed Brayton Cycle (CBC) Reports
  • Nikola Tesla Patent US1329559A (Valvular Conduit)
  • NASA Multi-Mission RTG (SiGe Thermoelectric) Data

Note: The core engineering concept of MagBiter and original sketches were created by me. AI tools were used as an assistant for thermodynamic calculations, research, and diagram visualization.
